rules.text: You have 100 nights to try your mattress for free with returns free and easy anytime after the 30-Night Adjustment Period.
rules.quote: We give you 100 nights to try your mattress for free. Returns are free and easy anytime after the 30-Night Adjustment Period.

rules.text: You can return pillows and bedding within 30 days of delivery or in-store purchase if unused and in original packaging and condition.
rules.quote: You can return your Casper item and get a full refund within 30 days of delivery or within 30 days of an in-store purchase, provided the merchandise is unused, and in its original packaging and condition.

rules.text: Furniture products have a 30-night trial period, extended to 100 nights if purchased with a paired mattress.
rules.quote: We offer a 30-night trial on our furniture products so that you can do just that. When you purchase your furniture with a paired mattress, we're happy to extend the trial to 100 nights to match that of your mattress.

rules.text: Glow, Mattress Topper, and Dog Bed products have a 30-night trial period.
rules.quote: Our Glows, Mattress Toppers, and Dog Bed all come with 30-night trials.

rules.text: Furniture can be returned without original packaging or box if in donate-able condition, even if assembled.
rules.quote: As long as your furniture is in donate-able condition, you can return it without the original packaging or box, even if it has been assembled.

rules.text: In-home delivery and setup service fees are non-refundable.
rules.quote: If you paid for our in-home delivery and setup service, we will not refund for the service performed.

rules.text: Refunds will be credited back to your account within two weeks.
rules.quote: Refunds will be credited back to your account within two weeks.

rules.text: Refunds are credited back to the original payment account.
rules.quote: Refunds will be credited back to your account within two weeks.
rules.reviewNote: The quote only states that refunds are credited back to 'your account' and does not specify 'original payment account.' The summary adds specificity not present in the quote.

rules.text: Shipping costs to Hawaii or Alaska are refunded if paid.
rules.quote: If you paid for shipping to Hawaii or Alaska, you’ll get a refund for those shipping costs as well.

rules.text: You may return a maximum of two items of the same product type.
rules.quote: You may return a maximum of two items of the same product type.
